field_lines.title: The lane marks
field_lines.speaker: protagonist
field_lines.text: White marks run out towards the fence. The field itself is quiet.

field_bleachers.title: The stands
field_bleachers.speaker: protagonist
field_bleachers.text: Two low concrete rows. Somebody left a bottle cap under the second step.
field_bleachers.repeat_text: The bottle cap is still under the step.

field_notice.title: The noticeboard
field_notice.speaker: protagonist
field_notice.text: The board lists regular practice times. One square has been rubbed out.
